lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਪੁਰਾਣਾ ਹੋਵੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਸੀਤਾ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਪਾਟੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: sach puraanaa hovai naahee seetaa kade na paatai ||
lines.translation: But the Truth does not grow old; and when it is stitched, it is never torn again.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਚੋ ਸਚਾ ਤਿਚਰੁ ਜਾਪੀ ਜਾਪੈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak saahib sacho sachaa tichar jaapee jaapai ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the Lord and Master is the Truest of the True. While we meditate on Him, we see Him. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 1 ||
lines.translation: First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚ ਕੀ ਕਾਤੀ ਸਚੁ ਸਭੁ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: sach kee kaatee sach sabh saar ||
lines.translation: The knife is Truth, and its steel is totally True.

lines.gurmukhi: ਘਾੜਤ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਅਪਰ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: ghaaRat tis kee apar apaar ||
lines.translation: Its workmanship is incomparably beautiful.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੇ ਸਾਣ ਰਖਾਈ ਲਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabade saan rakhaaee laai ||
lines.translation: It is sharpened on the grindstone of the Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਕੀ ਥੇਕੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: gun kee thekai vich samaai ||
lines.translation: It is placed in the scabbard of virtue.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਦਾ ਕੁਠਾ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੇਖੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: tis daa kuthaa hovai sekh ||
lines.translation: If the Shaykh is killed with that,

lines.gurmukhi: ਲੋਹੂ ਲਬੁ ਨਿਕਥਾ ਵੇਖੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: lohoo lab nikathaa vekh ||
lines.translation: then the blood of greed will spill out.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੋਇ ਹਲਾਲੁ ਲਗੈ ਹਕਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: hoi halaal lagai hak jaai ||
lines.translation: One who is slaughtered in this ritualistic way, will be attached to the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਰਿ ਦੀਦਾਰਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak dar deedaar samaai ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, at the Lord's door, he is absorbed into His Blessed Vision. ||2||

lines.transliteration: mah 1 ||
lines.translation: First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਮਰਿ ਕਟਾਰਾ ਬੰਕੁੜਾ ਬੰਕੇ ਕਾ ਅਸਵਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: kamar kataaraa ba(n)kuRaa ba(n)ke kaa asavaar ||
lines.translation: A beautiful dagger hangs by your waist, and you ride such a beautiful horse.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਰਬੁ ਨ ਕੀਜੈ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਮਤੁ ਸਿਰਿ ਆਵੈ ਭਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: garab na keejai naanakaa mat sir aavai bhaar ||3||
lines.translation: But don't be too proud; O Nanak, you may fall head first to the ground. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਜੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਚਲੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: so satasa(n)gat sabad milai jo guramukh chalai ||
lines.translation: They alone walk as Gurmukh, who receive the Shabad in the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਧਿਆਇਨਿ ਸੇ ਸਚੇ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਖਰਚੁ ਧਨੁ ਪਲੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: sach dhiaain se sache jin har kharach dhan palai ||
lines.translation: Meditating on the True Lord, they become truthful; they carry in their robes the supplies of the Lord's wealth.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਗਤ ਸੋਹਨਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਦੇ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਅਚਲੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhagat sohan gun gaavade guramat achalai ||
lines.translation: The devotees look beautiful, singing the Praises of the Lord; following the Guru's Teachings, they become stable and unchanging.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਤਨ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਭਲੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: ratan beechaar man vasiaa gur kai sabad bhalai ||
lines.translation: They enshrine the jewel of contemplation within their minds, and the most sublime Word of the Guru's Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਦਾ ਆਪੇ ਦੇਇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੧੯॥
lines.transliteration: aape mel milaaidaa aape dei vadiaaee ||19||
lines.translation: He Himself unites in His Union; He Himself grants glorious greatness. ||19||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਕੋਇ ਨਿਰਾਸਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasaa a(n)dar sabh ko koi niraasaa hoi ||
lines.translation: Everyone is filled with hope; hardly anyone is free of hope.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੋ ਮਰਿ ਜੀਵਿਆ ਸਹਿਲਾ ਆਇਆ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak jo mar jeeviaa sahilaa aaiaa soi ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, blessed is the birth of one, who remains dead while yet alive. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਆਸਾ ਹਥਿ ਹੈ ਕੇਉ ਨਿਰਾਸਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: naa kichh aasaa hath hai keu niraasaa hoi ||
lines.translation: Nothing is in the hands of hope. How can one become free of hope?

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਕਰੇ ਏਹ ਬਪੁੜੀ ਜਾਂ ਭੋੁਲਾਏ ਸੋਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: kiaa kare eh bapuRee jaa(n) bhoulaae soi ||2||
lines.translation: What can this poor being do? The Lord Himself creates confusion. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਸਚੇ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhrig jeevan sa(n)saar sache naam bin ||
lines.translation: Cursed is the life in this world, without the True Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਦਾਤਾਰ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਏਹੁ ਧਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: prabh daataa daataar nihachal ehu dhan ||
lines.translation: God is the Great Giver of givers. His wealth is permanent and unchanging.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਆਰਾਧੇ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਸੋਇ ਜਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: saas saas aaraadhe niramal soi jan ||
lines.translation: That humble being is immaculate, who worships the Lord with each and every breath.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਅਗਮੁ ਰਸਨਾ ਏਕੁ ਭਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)tarajaamee agam rasanaa ek bhan ||
lines.translation: With your tongue, vibrate the One Inaccessible Lord, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਰਬਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈ ॥੨੦॥
lines.transliteration: rav rahiaa sarabat naanak bal jaaee ||20||
lines.translation: He is all-pervading everywhere. Nanak is a sacrifice to Him. ||20||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
lines.translation: Salok, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਰਵਰ ਹੰਸ ਧੁਰੇ ਹੀ ਮੇਲਾ ਖਸਮੈ ਏਵੈ ਭਾਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: saravar ha(n)s dhure hee melaa khasamai evai bhaanaa ||
lines.translation: The union between the lake of the True Guru, and the swan of the soul, was pre-ordained from the very beginning, by the Pleasure of the Lord's Will.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਰਵਰ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਹੀਰਾ ਮੋਤੀ ਸੋ ਹੰਸਾ ਕਾ ਖਾਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: saravar a(n)dar heeraa motee so ha(n)saa kaa khaanaa ||
lines.translation: The diamonds are in this lake; they are the food of the swans.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਗੁਲਾ ਕਾਗੁ ਨ ਰਹਈ ਸਰਵਰਿ ਜੇ ਹੋਵੈ ਅਤਿ ਸਿਆਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: bagulaa kaag na rahaee saravar je hovai at siaanaa ||
lines.translation: The cranes and the ravens may be very wise, but they do not remain in this lake.

lines.gurmukhi: ਓਨਾ ਰਿਜਕੁ ਨ ਪਇਓ ਓਥੈ ਓਨੑਾ ਹੋਰੋ ਖਾਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: onaa rijak na paio othai onhaa horo khaanaa ||
lines.translation: They do not find their food there; their food is different.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚਿ ਕਮਾਣੈ ਸਚੋ ਪਾਈਐ ਕੂੜੈ ਕੂੜਾ ਮਾਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: sach kamaanai sacho paaeeai kooRai kooRaa maanaa ||
lines.translation: Practicing Truth, the True Lord is found. False is the pride of the false.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਕੌ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਜਿਨਾ ਧੁਰੇ ਪੈਯਾ ਪਰਵਾਣਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak tin kau satigur miliaa jinaa dhure paiyaa paravaanaa ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, they alone meet the True Guru, who are so pre-destined by the Lord's Command. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 1 ||
lines.translation: First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਉਜਲਾ ਜੇ ਕੋ ਚਿਤਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: saahib meraa ujalaa je ko chit karei ||
lines.translation: My Lord and Master is immaculate, as are those who think of Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋਈ ਸੇਵੀਐ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਜੋ ਦੇਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: naanak soee seveeai sadaa sadaa jo dei ||
lines.translation: O Nanak, serve Him, who gives to you forever and ever.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋਈ ਸੇਵੀਐ ਜਿਤੁ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਦੁਖੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: naanak soee seveeai jit seviai dukh jaai ||
lines.translation: O Nanak, serve Him; by serving Him, sorrow is dispelled.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਵਗੁਣ ਵੰਞਨਿ ਗੁਣ ਰਵਹਿ ਮਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਵਸੈ ਆਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: avagun va(n)njan gun ravahi man sukh vasai aai ||2||
lines.translation: Faults and demerits vanish, and virtues take their place; peace comes to dwell in the mind. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਆਪਿ ਤਾੜੀ ਲਾਈਅਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape aap varatadaa aap taaRee laaeean ||
lines.translation: He Himself is all-pervading; He Himself is absorbed in the profound state of Samaadhi.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਉਪਦੇਸਦਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਤੀਆਈਅਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape hee upadesadaa guramukh pateeaaeean ||
lines.translation: He Himself instructs; the Gurmukh is satisfied and fulfilled.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਆਪੇ ਉਝੜਿ ਪਾਇਅਨੁ ਇਕਿ ਭਗਤੀ ਲਾਇਅਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: ik aape ujhaR paaian ik bhagatee laaian ||
lines.translation: Some, He causes to wander in the wilderness, while others are committed to His devotional worship.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪਿ ਬੁਝਾਏ ਸੋ ਬੁਝਸੀ ਆਪੇ ਨਾਇ ਲਾਈਅਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis aap bujhaae so bujhasee aape naai laaeean ||
lines.translation: He alone understands, whom the Lord causes to understand; He Himself attaches mortals to His Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਸਚੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੨੧॥੧॥ ਸੁਧੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: naanak naam dhiaaeeai sachee vadiaaee ||21||1|| sudh ||
lines.translation: O Nanak, meditating on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, true greatness is obtained. ||21||1|| Sudh||
